action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Syntastic searched the current directory and its
parents for checker configuration files. If a user were tricked into
checking a file in a directory controlled by an attacker, the attacker
could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. After this update,
Syntastic only reads checker configuration files that are named in the
*_config_file options.
isummary:
Syntastic could be made to run programs as your login if it opened a
specially crafted file.
title: Syntastic vulnerability
